gloss_en: "Ve'ahavta" — 'And you shall love [the Lord your God]' (Deut 6:5), the qal perfect-consecutive verse-word of the Shema; in LM 1:210 it is the commandment fulfilled through honest business dealings (per Yoma 86a, 'that the Name of Heaven become beloved through you') and is identified as the aspect of Abraham, the lover of God — not any other form of the root אהב
